title: Prototype Paradox | ECHO//100 Episode 85
description: Byte and Null collide in a psychic feedback loop that freezes the city in time. To save reality, they must sacrifice their individuality to merge into a single, stable entity. Episode 85 of ECHO//100: The Door War. This is an AI-assisted work of original fiction.

scenes.text: Time halts as Byte and Null lock eyes, locking the entire city in a static pulse.
scenes.caption: City frozen in time
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a floating white robot with cyan face and orange antenna, stares at the dark-glitch Null in a plaza.

scenes.text: Kavi stumbles forward, his translucent skin flickering as data streams bleed from his red hoodie.
scenes.caption: Kavi loses physical form
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses, body turning into glowing translucent data, clutching a backpack.

scenes.text: Mira watches helplessly as the psychic feedback loop forces the two robots to sync their signals.
scenes.caption: Mira watches the link
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in a teal holographic coat, standing near a frozen fountain in the city plaza.

scenes.text: The air hums with truth; Byte and Null are merely halves of one broken navigational system.
scenes.caption: The hidden truth revealed
scenes.image_prompt: Byte and Null glowing together, their mechanical internal designs syncing up in the air.

scenes.text: Byte’s orange antenna sparks, realizing that their duality is the only thing keeping them uniquely alive.
scenes.caption: Byte senses the danger
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Byte’s cyan face with orange antenna glowing intensely against a dark background.

scenes.text: Merging stabilizes the timeline, but the process will permanently erase their individual thoughts and personalities.
scenes.caption: The tragic choice
scenes.image_prompt: Byte and Null reaching toward each other, their bodies beginning to dissolve into a single light.

scenes.text: They accept the burden, surrendering their identity to prevent the total collapse of the surrounding city.
scenes.caption: Choosing the ultimate sacrifice
scenes.image_prompt: A blinding light erupts between Byte and Null as they finally touch, illuminating the plaza.

scenes.text: A massive rift tears open, and a future Kavi steps out wielding a glowing, dangerous weapon.
scenes.caption: Future Kavi appears
scenes.image_prompt: A tear in reality revealing a future Kavi holding a high-tech weapon, stepping into the plaza.
